text: Publish this review page as the front door for changes
Publish the open-question register with a closure test per item
Regenerate every downloadable CSV from the page that cites it
Add a per-row evidence-tier badge (official / primary / community / estimate)
Publish a build-to-build change log
Mark each board row as scheduled, live or settled
License an authenticated, timestamped price archive
Refresh the pinned snapshot and re-run the full audit
Extend player-level data to 2023–2026 and re-estimate props
Capture real same-game parlay quotes
Get a written legal opinion before any prize is offered
Pre-register the next library and freeze it
Replace the trial-count lower bound with an auditable count
Add a placebo/permutation suite for parlays and props
Source archived forecasts with issue times for weather angles
Automate a dated weekly injury capture
Obtain a depth chart or starter/inactive source and classify depth
Build a replacement-level deficit index, but keep it out of the leaderboard
Pilot a participation-based depth proxy on 2019–2022
Raise parlay volume until ROI turns positive
Relax the gates so a strategy can be presented as a winner
Add a dated decision log (DECISIONS.md)
Separate pre-game 90-minute active/inactive lineup adjustments from starter-blind team ratings
Reconcile club 'Unofficial' depth charts with official NFL injury reports and mid-week transactions
Build a prospective pre-kickoff executable quote & bet-limit logger to unlock Gate G1
Capture player-prop thresholds, two-way prices, and actual Same-Game Parlay (SGP) joint quotes
Separate 'Frozen Historical Benchmark' from a versioned 'Weekly Live Slate Snapshot' on lines.html
Add a single-screen Matchup Decision Card combining originated line, injury string drops, and gate blockers
Provide an explicit 'Strict Official View' vs 'Labelled Research Numbers View' toggle with persistent warning banner
Model defensive secondary & front-seven backup cascades into opponent passing/rushing prop & total distributions
Establish an append-only git-signed Pre-Registration Trial Ledger before testing any new injury or prop signal
Incorporate the official T-90m roof/wall designation and certified pre-kickoff stadium weather lock
Replace flat-unit ROI leaderboard tie-breaking with Closing-Line Value (CLV) + Brier skill score during paper trading
Define explicit competition governance, non-monetary recognition charter, and jurisdictional compliance sign-off

Decide how research numbers are shown. Today every model, ROI, p-value and correlation cell on the public leaderboard is blank because the inputs are community files, so the dashboard cannot rank anything.
Obtain timestamped, executable sportsbook quotes (book, market, line, price, time, limit). Without them no ROI or closing-line value can be validated and gate G1 fails for every strategy.

Freeze the 18 strategy definitions and run them forward as a paper ledger: originated lines and selections are committed before kickoff, so the commit time is the proof that nothing was chosen with hindsight.
Refresh the pinned results-and-schedule snapshot on a schedule. The open line board was built from a snapshot pinned on 2026-11-02 and its first listed games are Week 8, already played.
Decide how availability enters the originated line. The tracker now shows who is out and who is next on the club's depth chart, but the line model does not use it.
Build the history needed to measure injury effects. The scheduled tracker stores a dated copy of every capture from today forward; earlier seasons are not in the repository.
Capture game-day inactive lists and actual starters. The injury report and depth chart are pre-game expectations; the inactive list is what actually happened.
Decide how to handle a club whose depth chart cannot be read as text. At the first capture one club page (Houston) published its chart as an image, so its rows are blank and flagged.
Obtain real prop prices and same-game-parlay quotes before ranking any prop combo. The prop module projects player lines but has no market price to compare against.
Register every strategy variant before it is tested. The deflated Sharpe ratio needs the true number of trials, and that number is unknown for the earlier exploratory work.
Define what the leaderboard reward is. The competition has gates and tiers but every reward is unawarded and no pool is defined.
Consolidate the site. The repository carries three generations of pages (root, lab/, archive/) and three pipelines (pipeline/, scripts/, analysis/); the top navigation has grown past a dozen links.
Extend the official score check from a sample to every game. The scheduled runner can reach NFL.com (the availability tracker proves it), which the build sandbox could not.

Change how parallel sessions claim work. Claims are pushed to each session's own branch, so sessions cannot see each other; the same request was claimed by several sessions on 2026-11-01 and again on 2026-11-12.
Capture pre-kickoff forecasts if weather is to be a feature. Weather fields were removed from the default model because their pre-game availability could not be verified.
Agree a staking rule before any real bet: fixed fraction, correlation-aware limits per game, and a stop rule. No such rule exists yet because nothing is validated.
Raise an alert when the tracker sees a first-listed quarterback, offensive lineman or defensive back designated Out or Doubtful.
Publish a decision register that lists every open question, what is known, what is not, and the decision each one blocks.
Add a dedicated suggestions section with an explicit accept / reject / implement workflow and a recorded decision.
Print a per-page "last verified" line naming the exact command that produced it.
Publish a machine-readable decisions.json so the state of every gate and suggestion can be diffed between builds.
Add a "what would change this decision" block to the executive summary.
Archive the official weekly injury report every week with a hash, so availability can be replayed for past seasons.
Obtain an official or licensed depth-chart / roster feed covering 2020-2026.
Obtain authenticated historical executable quotes: entry and closing price, timestamp, bookmaker, line and limits.
Obtain verified player-prop prices and joint same-game-parlay quotes.
Replace the 31-game official score sample with a full census of historical scores and pregame fields.
Record a complete trial registry: every model, feature, parameter and strategy variant ever tried, before evaluation.
Add lineup-availability inputs to the line-origination models: QB tier, position-group pressure, and whether a starter is ruled out.
Add opponent-specific defensive deficiency features by position group, not just a single team rating.
Split every feature into "known at decision time" and "known at settlement", and assert the split in code.
Measure how the market prices a backup quarterback, and compare that with the model's own estimate.
Add an availability gate: the availability feature must beat the market out of sample, not merely improve the model.
Make prospective, untouched replication a mandatory gate before any recognition or reward.
Recompute the deflated Sharpe with the registered trial count and publish the sensitivity.
State the reward pool, its custody and its payout obligation before any award, or state plainly that none exists.
Add a replication tier that rewards an untouched prospective window, separate from backtest rank.
Publish two leaderboards: an eligibility board and a risk-adjusted rank board, never a raw-profit board.
Keep the strict official-source row check in CI and make it fail the build.
Schedule a recurring rebuild and link check so the live site cannot drift from the pinned inputs.
Add the official news feed to the availability model as a flagged, human-reviewed input rather than ignoring it.
Build a market cross-check: does the spread move when a starter is ruled out, and by how much?
